The countdown is on to UKENIC26
29 October 2026
There’s still time to
book your tickets
for UKENIC26, our two-day conference in London on Monday 30 November and Tuesday 1 December.
Our team is busy making the final touches to the event, which will take place at the QEII Centre in the heart of Westminster.
This year's theme is: ‘Navigating change: shared challenges, collective solutions’, and continues conversations that started at ENIC NORTH in Glasgow earlier this year.
After more than 25 years, the UK ENIC conference continues to be one of the biggest education and skills events in the UK.
Hundreds of delegates from the international education sector attend each year including higher and further education admissions, management, marketing, recruitment, registry and compliance.
UKENIC26 will feature a packed programme of topical discussions, panels, workshops and presentations from experts across the sector.
Fraud, the International Education Strategy, Transnational Education, AI, Basic Compliance Assessment (BCA) and UK ENIC jargon-busting are just some of the subjects that will be discussed. You can read an overview of the programme
here
.

Ticket prices for the two-day conference are:
Members' Standard rate: £507 + VAT*
Non-Members' Standard rate: £558 + VAT*
*VAT at 20%, applies to UK based events
All tickets include lunch and refreshments throughout the conference, as well as entry to a networking reception at the end of day one.
Conference tickets are allocated to one delegate only. They cannot be shared by two delegates over two days.
Book your tickets
today so you don’t miss out.
Members may have inclusive places that they can use for the conference as part of their membership package. Members can contact their UK ENIC account manager or email
[email protected]
if unsure.
